description: Bhutan’s electricity regulator publishes distribution-reliability and transmission-performance reports, consumer power-quality studies, cost-overrun studies and annual reports. The page identifies recent named editions and historical annual reports. The provider is Electricity Regulatory Authority. Coverage: Coverage is Bhutan. Listed products include 2024 network performance, 2025 low-voltage quality and annual reports through 2024–2025. Access: The regulator’s public report index was read. No underlying reports or event records were downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: The index establishes report subjects and editions, not the numerical definitions or completeness of every indicator. Data reuse rights are not stated there. For simulation it provides official routes to reliability, service-quality and institutional evidence. Related resources: BPC and BPSO publications are separate operator sources, not substitutes for regulatory assessments.
